notes.title: Darkness Descends: Single Player Mode & New Goblin Chaos!
notes.content: [p]The goblin city has changed… and so have its merchants. ⚔️[/p][p]With our latest update, [i]Trade Rivals - Goblin Age[/i] takes a step deeper into the shadows. The streets are no longer safe, the marketplace no longer fair. Rivals sharpen their teeth in the dark, and new characters rise to claim their share of the chaos.[/p][p]🔥 [b]What’s New:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Single Player Mode[/b]: Face off against AI-driven rivals and sharpen your strategies without needing other players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Characters[/b]: Fresh goblin faces with unique personalities and dirty tricks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A Darker City[/b]: The setting has shifted into a tone that fits goblin ambition—schemes, betrayal, and shadowy deals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance Updates & Bug Fixes[/b] to keep the chaos fair… at least as fair as goblins can be.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you walk the streets alone or battle rivals in multiplayer, the goblin age grows darker, and the competition fiercer. Will you rise as the last merchant standing—or be swallowed by the night?[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update – What We’re Working On
notes.content: [p]Hey Goblins,[/p][p]We know it’s been a little quiet from us these past 2–3 weeks, but rest assured—we haven’t stopped working for a second. Many of you have been asking for it, and we’re excited to finally share that we’re deep in development on the [b]Single Player with Bots[/b] mode![/p][p]This has been one of the most requested features, and we can’t wait to deliver it to you. Very soon, you’ll be able to enjoy [i]Trade Rivals[/i] in a whole new way, even without a full party of players.[/p][p]We’re aiming to roll this out in a big upcoming update, and we’ll have more details to share soon. Thanks for your patience and for being part of our goblin community—we promise it’ll be worth the wait! 💚[/p]

notes.title: Panda Love & Speed Fixes – New Patch!
notes.content:
Hey Goblins!

We've made some important fixes around pricing and interactions with traveling merchants—especially for those of you moving at sonic speed and getting caught in unexpected bugs. Slow down... or don't! We got you covered either way.

Now for the real news:
Due to overwhelming demand, we’ve finally addressed the "Why can’t we love the panda?" issue.
Well, now you can. Love the panda as much as your goblin heart desires. 💖
(Finny, you can sleep peacefully now.)

As always, thanks for your feedback—keep it coming!

notes.title: New Update – Your Game, Your Rules!
notes.content:
Hey Goblins!

This week, a bunch of new goblins joined our chaotic little world—thank you all for playing Trade Rivals and supporting us! If you’re enjoying the game and recommending it to others, don’t forget to leave a review. It really helps!

Now onto the big news:
We’re rolling out one of the most game-changing updates yet! From now on, the host can customize the core game settings before starting a match:

🛠️ Choose the number of days the game will last
🎯 Set how much reputation is needed to win
💰 Decide how much gold players start with
💥 And even control whether sabotage can lead to bankruptcy

Basically, you can now tailor the game to your playstyle—create your own perfect chaos!

We’ve also:

🐞 Fixed several glitches, bugs, and collider issues reported by the community
🎁 Added a few small easter eggs as a thank-you to early supporters, streamers, and influencers

Your feedback keeps shaping this game. Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us on Steam Discussions or Discord.

We love you all—happy trading, and may the richest goblin win! 💚

notes.title: Fast Feet & Smoother Streets
notes.content: [p][b]Greetings Goblins,[/b][/p][p]We’re rolling out daily fixes on our quest for perfection—and today’s update brings a little extra magic to your travels:[/p][list][*][p][b]Speedy Shop‑Square Transit:[/b] A sprinkling of enchantment now lets you dash between your shop and the town square faster when you venture out for sabotages or fairy errands.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Easier Merchant Hauls:[/b] Goods bought from wandering traders are now a breeze to carry—no more juggling awkward crates![/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Bug Squash:[/b] We’ve also stomped out a handful of small bugs to keep your gameplay smooth.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and for all your feedback—we’re not stopping until this is the ultimate Goblin experience![/p]

notes.title: No More Getting Stuck!
notes.content:
We've added a life-saving feature to the "Esc" button to help with potential stuck situations. Getting trapped will no longer ruin your gameplay experience!
We've also fixed some edge cases we discovered, along with a few localization issues.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Greetings Goblins,

The first-day fix is always important! Thanks to the feedback from our players, we’ve addressed a missing collision issue and added an extra connection check.

We truly appreciate your support and will keep improving the game!

notes.title: Trade Rivals - Goblin Age launches July 14th! News & Mechanics!
notes.content:
[p][b]The Goblin Age begins July 14th![/b][/p][p]After many sleepless nights, weird bugs, goblin squabbles, and even weirder feature requests — [i]Trade Rivals - Goblin Age[/i] is finally launching into Early Access![/p][p]But make no mistake: this isn’t a “release and vanish” kind of story. We're a small team, but we're here for the long haul — just like your nosy neighbor goblin. Expect constant updates, new features, and direct communication with us on both [b]Discord[/b] and [b]Steam Discussions[/b]. We're here 24/7, reading every message, fixing every (goblin-caused) bug, and listening to your crazy ideas.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]What’s new in this Early Access version?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We've squashed countless bugs! (Sorry, bug goblin.)[/p][/*][*][p]Characters got a big makeover — and we've added a bunch of brand new goblins to the crew.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]sell your shelves[/b] and customize your [b]product boxes[/b] from shelf items.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Wheel of Chance[/b] is cheaper now (you're welcome!) and contains powerful new rewards, including up to [b]200 gold[/b] and [b]10 reputation[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]From Day 2, mysterious [b]outside traders[/b] arrive selling rare, cheap, but low-stock items. Be fast to profit![/p][/*][*][p]A cheeky little [b]fountain fairy[/b] now grants you 3 chances per day — buff your shop, debuff your rivals, run like Sonic, or slow others like turtles![/p][/*][*][p]Oh, and did we mention? A [b]crime syndicate[/b] has infiltrated the city. With a bit of coin, they’ll [i]“redecorate”[/i] your rivals' shops, steal their goods, or drain their pockets. Totally fair, right?[/p][/*][/list][p]🎯 [b]What’s next?[/b]
This is just the beginning. We’ve got tons of features planned post-launch — new cards, sabotage mechanics, more goblins, seasonal events, and surprises we can’t talk about... yet.[/p][p]💬 [b]Stay connected![/b]
Join our Discord, leave feedback on Steam Discussions, or just send us goblin memes. We’re always around and we love building this world [i]with[/i] you.[/p][p]Let’s make chaos profitable.
See you in the Goblin Age. 💚[/p][p]— The Trade Rivals Team[/p]

notes.title: Trade Rivals: Goblin Age Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p][b]Welcome to the Goblin Market![/b]
[i]Trade Rivals: Goblin Age[/i] is a competitive shop management game for 2–4 players, where clever pricing, sneaky sabotage, and economic chaos rule the day. Starting with a humble shop, players must purchase shelves and items, set prices, and attract customers – all while outwitting their rivals.[/p][p]💀 Think you’ve got what it takes to become the richest goblin merchant? Prove it by:[/p][list][*][p]Sabotaging your friends’ shops with curses and market tricks[/p][/*][*][p]Mastering the shifting economy in randomized scenarios[/p][/*][*][p]Winning customers through smart pricing (or dirty tactics)[/p][/*][*][p]Facing daily challenges and surviving 15 cutthroat days[/p][/*][*][p]Climbing to 100 reputation or being the last goblin standing![/p][/*][/list][p]🧪 The demo features a full 5-day game loop, random economic events, sabotage cards, and all the goblin mischief you can handle.[/p][p]📅 [i]Available during Steam Next Fest – play the demo, share feedback, and wishlist now![/i][/p]

notes.title: Minor UX Improvements & Crash Fixes
notes.content:
In this patch, we’ve made small but meaningful improvements to the user experience and fixed a few crash issues reported by the community. We’re aware that the update size is larger than expected for the scope of changes, and we’re currently working on optimizing our patching system. Our goal is to ensure that minor updates come with minor download sizes moving forward.
Thanks for your continued support and patience!

notes.title: Demo is Ready: Your First Step Into Goblin Capitalism
notes.content:
Before the full economic chaos of Early Access, you can now get your first hands-on taste of shelf-stocking, price-cutting, and deliciously shady sabotage.

In this demo, you’ll:

🛒 Manage your own medieval shop
🤝 Trade with the supplier (or hoard like a rat)
💰 Undercut rivals and win the customer war
🧙 Partner with a witch to sabotage your competition (because who plays fair, really?)

This isn’t just a demo—it’s a trial by trade, a peek into a world where every coin counts, reputations crumble, and the greediest goblin wins.

Play now, break the economy (or your friendships), and let us know what kind of chaos you create. Don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t already—Early Access is creeping closer!

The goblin market is open. Enter if you dare.

— The Trade Rivals Team
